common.principle: Meros never tells anyone whom to marry or what to decide. Success means understanding, timely access to qualified counselling, and confident personal choice.

ds.title: Design system
ds.intro: Every token, typeface, component and state used in Meros. Screens may only use what is shown here.
ds.coloursNote: Burgundy is the brand colour, never a warning colour. Data cyan is for numbers and charts only. Ink variants keep gold and cyan text at WCAG AA in Pearl mode.
ds.typeNote: Sora for Latin display, Readex Pro for body and UI in both scripts, tabular figures for data.
ds.spacingNote: Spacing 4, 8, 12, 16, 24, 32, 48, 64, 96, 128. Radius 12 controls, 20 cards, 28 hero panels, full pills.
ds.statesNote: Hover, press, focus and disabled are shown on every interactive element. Try Tab to see the focus glow.
ds.cardBody: Frosted glass, hairline border, top edge highlight. Hover with a mouse to see the gentle tilt and moving light.
ds.goldCardBody: Gold is reserved for consent, the reveal and a shared gene.
ds.pillsNote: Every content block and AI message carries exactly one label. Clinical advice only comes from a named, accredited human.
ds.inputHint: Optional. Only your counsellor will see this.
ds.inputError: Please write at least three words so your counsellor understands.
ds.choiceLegend: How would you like to read your result?
ds.switchLabel: Share only shared carrier genes with my partner
ds.switchDesc: For 90 days. You can withdraw at any time.
ds.dataNote: Numbers count up gently and use tabular figures. Risk is never shown in red.
ds.fourSummary: When both parents are carriers, each pregnancy has a 1 in 4 chance of being affected, a 2 in 4 chance of being a carrier, and a 1 in 4 chance of being neither.
ds.hundredSummary: Out of 100 pregnancies, about 25 would be affected, about 50 would be carriers and about 25 would be neither.
ds.emptyBody: When you book a session with a genetic counsellor, it will appear here with everything you need to prepare.
ds.errorTitle: We couldn't load this right now
ds.errorBody: Your information is safe. Please try again in a moment.
ds.sheetBody: On phones, actions open in a sheet within reach of your thumb. On larger screens it floats in the centre.
ds.helixNote: Lazy loaded 3D. With reduced motion or no WebGL, the still helix is shown instead.
ds.motionNote: Easing cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), 300 to 700 ms, staggered 50 ms. Difficult news is never revealed abruptly.
ds.combinedNote: combined chance per pregnancy when a couple shares two carrier genes (1 − ¾ × ¾)
ds.combinedSummary: Out of 100 pregnancies, about 44 would be affected by at least one of the two conditions.
ds.perPregnancyGrid: One shared gene, out of 100 pregnancies
